posts.title: An iPad Mini in Your Pocket
posts.description: Recently I was holding my iPhone Duo in its unfolded state and I needed an SMS 2FA code and I started to look around for my phone before realizing I was holding it. This has happened at least 4-5 times already and I’ve had the phone for less than a week. It constantly tricks my brain into thinking it’s an iPad Mini, not a phone.
